selection.ownership: Freshworks Inc. (Delaware corporation; San Mateo, California HQ; Nasdaq FRSH). Freshteam is the Freshworks HR/ATS product, not Freshdesk.

research.searchCoverage: Bounded 2026-09-13 review of official Freshteam REST docs (Bearer API key from API Settings, https://<account>.freshteam.com/api/employees and /api/job_postings), Freshworks corporate identity, and the historical Codecov incident disclosed in the Freshworks S-1. Freshteam is not a Freshdesk alias. This is not a breach-free claim.

exception.authority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 for historical non-China incidents
exception.incident: Freshworks S-1 (August 2021) discloses that the April 2021 Codecov supply-chain incident exposed credentials in Freshworks' development environment and a limited amount of customer information; Freshworks reported no evidence of source-code modification or product impact.
exception.remediation: Exposed credentials were rotated, logs were reviewed, a third-party forensics firm was engaged, and relevant customers were asked to rotate credentials.
exception.residualRisk: Historical third-party CI credential exposure remains a residual risk; live authentication unverified.
exception.adoption: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 explicitly permits historical non-China incident adoption for these Freshteam operations.
exception.usefulness: Employee, recruiting, time-off, and new-hire HTTP operations plus EventOnly employee webhooks.

research.searchCoverage: Official Freshteam REST API (Bearer token from API Settings, tenant host <account>.freshteam.com, /api prefix on employees and job_postings), product identity distinct from Freshdesk, Freshworks Inc. Delaware/San Mateo HQ, and historical Codecov incident in the 2021 S-1. Bounded coverage is not a breach-free claim.

incidents.finding: Codecov vendor compromise allowed access to credentials in Freshworks' development environment and copying of source code plus a limited amount of customer information. Freshworks reported no evidence of unauthorized source-code modification or product impact.
incidents.remediation: Credentials rotated; third-party forensics; relevant customers contacted to rotate credentials.
incidents.limitation: Historical incident; no current unresolved Freshteam-product compromise identified in reviewed coverage as of 2026-09-13.

research.waiverAuthority: User waiver dated 2026-09-13 permits historical non-China incident coverage.

adaptations: Credential-only healthcheck probes GET /api/employees?page=1, matching the pinned validator, and accepts empty input. Domain is a required stored setup field used only in the bounded host https://{{domain}}.freshteam.com.

Returns the raw Freshteam JSON array under data. Official overview writes GET /employees; curl samples and pinned source use /api/employees. Optional page (default 1) and status (active|inactive) are the documented query names. Pagination Link headers are not followed.
employeeId is percent-encoded as one path segment on GET /api/employees/{id}. include comma-join is omitted.
